decision: Attach a one-minute thread heartbeat to the already-running local branch watcher so verified remote changes trigger re-ingestion while unchanged heads remain quiet.
source: User request to watch the three collaboration branches for updates.
scope: Operational monitoring and follow-up only; no matching, selection or rendering authority.
reason: The local background service records changes, while the heartbeat lets the current task act on meaningful changes without producing unchanged-status messages.
